title: JSFL: doc.exportSWF(path) missing from runtime
description: fl.getDocumentDOM().exportSWF(fileURL) is not implemented in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts. The JsflDocument interface and its proxy do not have exportSWF. Any JSFL script calling doc.exportSWF('file:///...') throws a runtime error. Fix: add exportSWF(fileURL: string) to the JsflDocument interface and the proxy implementation in runtime.ts. In the browser context, the fileURL parameter cannot be used to write to disk — instead, trigger the same publish flow as the existing publish() method (which returns Uint8Array) and optionally offer a download. The implementation should at minimum not throw and should invoke the publish pipeline. Lines of interest: JsflDocument interface ~line 843-876, proxy implementation ~1274-1286.
